bugs_found: transfer does not normalize/validate amount as Decimal; float/NaN/infinite or non-Decimal inputs can raise inconsistently or corrupt balances
transfer is non-atomic: debit is applied before credit, so a failure in account_to.balance addition can lose funds
fx_convert accepts zero/negative FX rates, allowing conversion to zero or negative balances
compound_interest accepts negative principal and silently truncates fractional years/compounds_per_year via int()
loan_payment silently truncates fractional months via int()
functions do not reject non-finite Decimal values such as NaN/Infinity, causing exceptions or nonsensical financial outputs
money results are never rounded/quantized to currency precision, allowing fractional-cent drift
